Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in the first step by misinterpreting the birth years of the directors. After correctly identifying Erich von Stroheim (born 1885) and Mario Missiroli (born 1934), the Planner concluded that "Erich von Stroheim is younger than Mario Missiroli." This is factually incorrect; 1885 is earlier than 1934, meaning Stroheim was born first and is therefore the older director. The Planner failed to perform the basic arithmetic comparison (1934 > 1885) required to determine who is younger, leading to the wrong final answer.
